verdict.rationale: Featurebase's first-party docs describe a changelog product: a standalone branded page on a custom domain with email subscriptions, embeddable in-app changelog widgets, and release notes targeted by user attributes. It also automatically notifies users when their requests ship, which directly closes the loop with customers. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth documentation of the changelog publishing workflow (e.g. editor or API for changelog entries).
